## 🎯 Feature Overview (Why?)  
Describe what the feature should do and why. Add Cdc references if applicable.  

## 🧩 Perspective  
Describe expected behaviors, views, or calculations.  
- User actions  
- Data transformations or calculations  
- Edge cases

## 🎨 Design  
Add Figma link, screenshots, or design notes.

## 📖 User Stories  
As a [role], I want to [action] so that [benefit].  
List all relevant stories.

## 💬 What We Need  
List what is required to move forward (texts, rules, formats, validations, decisions, etc.).  
- [ ] Example

## 💾 Sample Data (if applicable)  
- APIs or endpoints involved  
- Example payloads or schemas  
- Links to sample datasets  

## ⚙️ Clarifications Needed  
List open questions or dependencies to resolve before FEAT/TASK creation.  

## ✅ Success Criteria  
Expected functional outcomes to later become [FEAT] or [TASK] items.  
- [ ] Example
